title: TCP/IP Send
text: Send data over TCP/IP network to specified remote machine, 1 input; {Remote address} sets the remote host name or address remote host name or IP, {Port} sets the remote host port, {Verify address and port connectivity} sets the remote machine connection verification, {Byte order} sets the sequential order, {Enable blocking mode} sets the simulation waits while sending data, {Timeout} sets the allowed time to complete operations and {Transfer Delay} sets the enables delayed acknowledgment. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Data
ports.summary: Data values to send vector | matrix | array

params.name: Remote address
params.values: Remote host name or address remote host name or IP address

params.name: Port
params.values: Remote host port 80 (default) | remote host port

params.name: Byte order
params.values: Sequential order of bytes big-endian (default) | little-endian

params.name: Enable blocking mode
params.values: Simulation waits while sending data on (default) | off

params.name: Timeout
params.values: Allowed time to complete operations 10 (default) | positive scalar
